estimates.definition: Conditional sensitivity only, not achieved or expected savings: 10% of measured successful-run step cost / sample window days. Failed/cancelled runs excluded from this opportunity denominator; all costs retained in actual accounting.

method.quantiles: R-7 linear interpolation: sorted[(n-1)*p], interpolated between adjacent observations; seconds rounded to 0.1. n=1 is an observation, not a stable tail estimate.
method.successfulTimingPopulation: Only jobs and steps in workflow runs with conclusion=success; failed/cancelled workflows remain in actual runner cost and outcome inventory.
method.runnerTime: Sum non-skipped jobs with steps and valid started/completed timestamps; no per-job billing rounding or paid-runner multiplier.
method.queue: Initial queue=earliest executed job.started_at-run.created_at; job dispatch queue=job.started_at-job.created_at. Dependency wait is not runner queue.
method.grouping: event + head branch + observed executed check-job footprint + head workflow blob + head historical-fixture runner blob; ci-scope and integration-runner blobs also recorded. Exact selected files/PR synthetic checkout/cache hits are unknown.
method.dailyRate: All selected-run runner seconds / 60 / (49850/86400), attributed by run creation in (excluded run creation, listObservedAt]; short-window normalization only, not a long-term mean.
